Test Description: Testing ability to optimize moves or scoring for a given game state and trying to have a grounded rule application
Difficulty Notes: Easy optimization problem with intuitive solution
Question: Considering the situation that the blue player has two turns one after the other, and that the game ends after these 2 turns. Identify the two tiles the blue player choose from the available tile options (A, B, C) so as to get the maximum score by the end of the game? Assume the players all have multiple meeples in their private supplies. Return the max. score gain possible in the following format: [total_points_turn = <the maximum points by the end of two turns, but before end-of-game scoring>, total_points_final = <maximum final score after end-of-game scoring>]
